scientific.integrity: The paper-form recurrence is linearized exactly at the deterministic quadratic optimum. The squared prediction error has zero first derivative there, producing a block-triangular Jacobian whose Schur conditions are necessary and sufficient for local exponential stability.
limitations: The exact fixed-point theorem is for the autonomous source-theory recurrence; the debiased source algorithm shares the same strict asymptotic local frontier through its limiting Jacobian.
The theorem is scalar, deterministic, local, and excludes rectification, AMSGrad, and weight decay.
Different libraries may use different epsilon placement.
Nonlinear dynamics outside the local frontier are not classified.

title: Exact epsilon-curvature local stability frontier for AdaBelief
